title: MocapStateV2
description: Observed Motion Capture recorder state (failures F6/F7). The live run proved a two-step start: the first start enters waiting_for_selection, only a second start begins recording. Command dispatch alone is never a state transition — state comes from classified client feedback; unknown feedback maps to the unknown state and fails closed.

last_feedback.description: Raw last observed client feedback line (for evidence); may be truncated.

last_feedback_key.description: Stable translation/content key when the game provided one; null when only rendered text was available.
